name: Greenhouse Marketplace
summary: Greenhouse Marketplace is a 142,638-square-foot community shopping center in San Leandro with prime Interstate 880 access, featuring multiple anchors, diverse retailers, and outparcel restaurants. The center serves a high-density East Bay community and benefits from long-term tenant success with impressive sales performance.
demographics: Greenhouse Marketplace serves a high-density Northern California community with a diverse demographic profile. The trade area shows a median household income of $95,869 within 1 mile, increasing to $112,989 within 10 miles, indicating a solidly middle-class to upper-middle-class customer base. The center draws from a population of over 848,000 within 10 miles, with approximately 281,834 households in the broader trade area. The daytime population of 807,560 within 10 miles suggests significant employment centers nearby, attracting both residential shoppers and working professionals for convenience-oriented shopping and dining.
description: Greenhouse Marketplace is a thriving community shopping center strategically located at 699 Lewelling Boulevard in San Leandro, California, with exceptional access to Interstate 880, one of Northern California's busiest freeways. Spanning 142,638 square feet of gross leasable area, this well-established center serves an exceptionally high-density community in the San Francisco-Oakland-Berkeley metro area. The property features multiple anchor tenants complemented by a diverse mix of small shop retailers, professional services, and restaurants on outparcels, creating a comprehensive shopping and dining destination. The center's long-term tenants have demonstrated outstanding success with impressive sales performance, testament to the loyal customer base drawn from the surrounding affluent trade area with median household incomes exceeding $100,000. With ample parking at a ratio of 7.75 spaces per 1,000 square feet and convenient freeway access, Greenhouse Marketplace continues to serve as a vital retail hub for San Leandro residents and the broader East Bay community.
